verdict.rationale: A/B testing is a fair question for an email marketing platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions A/B or variant testing, or automatic winner selection based on engagement. It only documents setting a single subject line, post-send statistics, and suppressing unengaged contacts. None of these is the capability itself.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can A/B test subject lines or content variants and have the winner picked from real engagement
